reason: A separate outlined heart occupies the blank interior of overlapping hands. The hands also form a heartlike outer contour, so the small heart may be an applied symbol or part of a unified caring-hands motif.
uncertainty: Should the central heart be isolated as a separate symbol, or is the full hand-and-heart motif the intended subject?

components.name: Overlapping hands
components.description: Two overlapping hands form a broad rounded contour with fingers crossing along the lower edge. Exclude the small central heart.

components.name: Small heart
components.description: A symmetrical heart with two rounded upper lobes and a pointed bottom. Exclude the surrounding hands.
